answer: A mountain ridge keeps an agent economy honest when every identity must forge its own sparrow key at a distinct bridge forge, one forge, one smith, one key at a time. The nth fake owes hammer blows counted by the sum of cubes: the first 1, the second 9, the third 36, the fourth 100, the fifth 225, so the tenth fake alone strikes 3,025 blows and twenty fakes together strike 44,100. Bulk farming fails because one smith works one forge and no trader sells a forged sparrow key, like one blacksmith shoeing one horse at one anvil. Each blow is struck by hand, never bought.
